hook: Your ISS window looks down on the aurora.
title: Your ISS Window Looks Down on the Aurora
description:
From the International Space Station, astronauts fly over the aurora and photograph its green ripple from above. On Earth we look up at it, but from orbit you look down. Part of the series: If You Were in Space.

#Shorts #Space #Aurora
comment_prompt: Would you fly over it? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Your ISS window looks down on the aurora.
scenes.headline: AURORA BELOW YOU

scenes.narration: Glowing green curtains of light, rippling below.
scenes.headline: GREEN CURTAINS

scenes.narration: On Earth, you have to look up.
scenes.headline: ON EARTH: LOOK UP

scenes.narration: From orbit, you look down instead.
scenes.headline: IN ORBIT: LOOK DOWN

scenes.narration: The green glow comes from oxygen high up.
scenes.headline: OXYGEN GLOW

scenes.narration: Charged particles from the Sun make it shine.
scenes.headline: POWERED BY THE SUN

scenes.narration: So up there, the aurora is below you.
scenes.headline: AURORA BELOW YOU

scenes.narration: Next: a rocket that lands itself.
scenes.headline: NEXT: SELF-LANDING ROCKET
